description: AGENTS.md와 공통 하네스 계약을 집행하는 Codex 어댑터

hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "& node (Join-Path (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) 'aidd-guide/harness/runtime/pretool-bootstrap.mjs') codex '.codex/hooks/file-chain.mjs'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $fallback = @{hookSpecificOutput = @{hookEventName = 'PreToolUse'; permissionDecision = 'deny'; permissionDecisionReason = 'file protection entry failed; repair the bootstrap or adapter with the shell.'}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 3; [Console]::Out.Write($fallback); exit 0 }"
